title: lessingianthus ligulifolius
intro: Lessingianthus ligulifolius, commonly known as the "Broomstick" or "Tree Broom", is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Lessingianthus ligulifolius include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-inflammatory effects.
